summary: In MBW's World Leaders series, Believe's Managing Director, Americas Alejandra Olea explains how Spanish artist Iñigo Quintero's independent hit Si No Estás topped Spotify's Global Top 50, Believe's first-ever chart-topper there. She credits teamwork with the label Acqustic, data-driven marketing and partnerships with Spotify and TikTok. Olea argues Latin artists have led a wider shift toward deals with more control, transparency and better economics, with independent hits rising in many markets without major label support.
one_line: Believe's Alejandra Olea explains how Iñigo Quintero's independent hit Si No Estás reached No.1 globally and why artists worldwide are choosing deals outside major labels.
key_facts: Iñigo Quintero's Si No Estás, released September 23, reached the top of Spotify's Global Top 50 in late October 2023 and was still at No.7 in early December.
Si No Estás has over 330 million plays on Spotify and over 100 million on YouTube.
Si No Estás is Believe's first-ever chart-topper on Spotify's Global Top 50.
Iñigo Quintero signed to Acqustic in March 2023, and Believe has worked with him since March; Believe had identified Acqustic as a promising new label in 2020.
The track has been included in over 180 playlists across digital partners, including 79+ Spotify playlists with over 97 million followers, and Spotify's Today's Top Hits.
Believe's partnership with TikTok has resulted in more than 5 million creations of the track, according to MediaMatch.
Believe built Iñigo's YouTube channel from scratch with an official lyric video, which has reached 100 million views and ranks #13 on YouTube's Top 100 Global Music Videos.
Believe operates in 50 countries and offers services from self-release with TuneCore to premium Believe Label and Artist Solutions.
Olea says artists want to keep ownership of their masters and get better economics, with more freedom, transparency and options.
In France, the Top 5 albums of the week of June 16th were all by artists signed to Believe directly or through their labels.
RAF Camora's XV RR hit #1 in the Official German Album Charts in June 2023, and Blanco has been rising in the UK.
Grupo Frontera's album El Comienzo, released early August, peaked at #1 on several Spotify debut charts and has over 1.6 billion streams on Spotify.
